correctness.rationale: Exact deck-image classification yields the minimum of two squared candidate lengths; a degree-two torus homomorphism makes horizontal sum and difference independent Haar-uniform. The vertical difference has an exact triangular density. A fully evaluated positive-part integral and symmetry in squared horizontal variables give the one-dimensional correction and its elementary antiderivative. An integral bound proves the strict torus inequality for all positive parameters; local expansion proves the 7/2 fractional onset and C^3/non-C^4 regularity. Independent direct deck enumeration, exact rational special values, symbolic identities, quadrature and Monte Carlo passed; experiments are not used as infinite proofs.
